instagram_caption: The first Wiki that I worked on called Robopedia at MITRE was the robotics Wiki that we used to document everything within the robotics program I was working on. and the lead of that program said it didn't happen if it's not in the wiki. And so absolutely every meeting, every interaction between any people, any piece of hardware, equipment, any software had to get documented in the wiki. And if you tried to tell him something, his first question was, is it in the wiki? And if it wasn't in the wiki, he didn't want to hear about it until after it was. And that was absolutely critical to getting adoption.
